offering_description.value: Provides less-than-truckload (LTL) freight transportation for businesses, moving palletized shipments through a network of service centers using its own trucks and drivers. Also offers expedited, container drayage and supply chain related services.

primary_services.value: less-than-truckload freight shipping; expedited freight; container drayage; truckload brokerage; supply chain consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: shippers such as manufacturers, distributors, retailers and industrial businesses

end_markets.value: manufacturing; retail; wholesale distribution; construction; industrial supply

revenue_model.value: service fees: freight charges per shipment based on weight, class, distance and accessorials

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs terminals, tractors and trailers, carrying freight for shippers; service provider: transportation and logistics services sold to business shippers

geography_served.value: North America: All 50 US states, with service to Canada, Mexico and other international destinations via partners

specialization.value: related lines: LTL freight with related expedited, drayage and logistics services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales force serving shippers and national accounts; online: web tools for quotes, tracking and shipment booking

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: trucking safety, hours-of-service and emissions rules from the US DOT, FMCSA and EPA
